common.reasonOptional: Optional — it helps us improve suggestions.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

search.title: Search your meetings
search.hint: Searches transcripts and summaries — every hit keeps its source and timestamp.
search.placeholder: Type a word or a question…
search.startBody: Type at least two characters and we'll show the segment, meeting and timestamp.
search.noResultsBody: Try a shorter or different word.

dashboard.pendingBody: Nothing runs unless you approve it yourself.

stats.needsReviewHint: Still analyzing or waiting for review
stats.decisionsHint: Every decision links back to its source

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.subtitle: Every meeting with its summary, decisions and tasks — and the source behind each one.
meetings.deleteBody: “{{title}}” and all of its summaries and tasks will be removed. This can't be undone.
meetings.emptyBody: Record a meeting or upload an audio file and Dawwen will produce the summary, decisions and tasks.
meetings.noMatchesBody: Try a different search term or filter.
meetings.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.

newModal.title: New meeting
newModal.description: Record the meeting or upload the audio, and Dawwen handles the rest.
newModal.titleHint: A clear title makes it easier to find later.
newModal.titleRequired: Add a title for the meeting first.
newModal.demoHint: Demo mode uses a prepared transcript and analysis so you can see the full experience without uploading audio.
newModal.recordHint: Recording starts after you confirm participants' consent. Audio is transcribed and then deleted.
newModal.dropzoneText: Drop an audio file here, or click to browse
newModal.micError: Couldn't reach the microphone. Check your browser permission.
newModal.consentCheckbox: I confirm every participant agrees to record and process this meeting.
newModal.consentHint: No processing happens without this confirmation. Raw audio is deleted after transcription.

meeting.deleteBody: “{{title}}” and all of its output will be removed. This can't be undone.

history.title: Edit history
history.empty: No edits recorded for this meeting.

summary.noTldr: No summary for this meeting yet.
summary.topicsHint: Each topic keeps the timestamp where it was discussed.
summary.decisionsHint: Approve the decisions you've verified — each one keeps its source.
summary.noDecisions: No decisions extracted from this meeting.
summary.questionsHint: Things that were asked and still need an answer.
summary.needsReviewBody: Items marked “Needs review” are missing an owner or a due date. Fill them in before approving.

task.emptyBody: Change the filter or extract tasks from the transcript.

transcript.emptyBody: Try another word, or clear the search.

proposals.hint: These proposals don't run until you approve them in the proposals inbox.
proposals.emptyBody: When you ask Dawwen to schedule a meeting or send a message, the proposal appears here.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.subtitle: Your upcoming meetings in one place — start a recording or open the minutes from here.
calendar.disconnectBody: No meeting is deleted — syncing just stops until you reconnect.
calendar.emptyBody: Connect your calendar or start a meeting without one.

proposals.title: Proposals inbox
proposals.subtitle: Dawwen proposes, you decide. Nothing runs on its own.
proposals.guaranteeBody: Any action — scheduling, sending, reminding or deleting — arrives here as a proposal and only runs with your approval.
proposals.emptyBody: When you ask Dawwen for an action, it appears here before anything runs.
proposals.emptyPendingBody: Nothing is waiting for your approval right now.
proposals.approvedCalendar: The meeting was added to your calendar.
proposals.rejectHint: Add a short reason (optional) — nothing will be executed.

ask.title: Ask Dawwen
ask.subtitle: Answers from your meetings, always with sources
ask.welcomeMeeting: Hi! I'm Dawwen's assistant for “{{title}}”. Ask me about any decision, task or timestamp, or ask me to propose a time or draft a message.
ask.welcomeGeneral: Hi! Ask me anything that was said across your meetings and I'll answer with the source and timestamp.
ask.placeholder: Ask anything… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
ask.honestUnknown: That detail isn't in the transcript, so I won't guess.
ask.proposalNeedsApproval: A proposal that needs your approval before running
ask.errorBody: I can't reach the assistant right now. Please try again.

billing.title: Billing
billing.subtitle: Pay as you go — every transcription minute and token is metered at its real cost.
billing.emptyTransactionsBody: Your first top-up will show up here.
billing.emptyUsageBody: Once you process a meeting, its real cost appears here.
billing.topupBody: Top-ups are manual transfers; the amount is added after confirmation.
billing.customAmountHint: Use this if you want a different amount, in USD.
billing.referenceHint: The transfer ID or a note that ties it to the payment.
billing.manualNote: After transferring, send the reference here. Your balance updates once the payment is reviewed — there is no automatic charge.
billing.howStep1Body: Add credit and only the real usage is deducted from it.
billing.howStep2Body: Transcription minutes, analysis tokens and embeddings — each with its cost.
billing.howStep3Body: See every transaction and operation, with no surprises on the invoice.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Control language, timezone and audio retention — your data stays yours.
settings.generalHint: These affect how dates and times appear across every meeting.
settings.timezoneHint: All dates are displayed in this timezone.
settings.retentionDesc: Raw audio is deleted after transcription by default. You can keep it for a limited time for review.
settings.retentionHint0: Audio is deleted right after transcription.
settings.retentionHint7: Audio stays available for review for a week.
settings.retentionHint30: Audio stays for a month — less private.
settings.privacyNote: Transcripts and tokens are never logged.
settings.dataExportDesc: Download a JSON copy of your account and meetings — take it with you anytime.
settings.dangerZoneDesc: Deleting your account permanently removes every meeting, summary and task.
settings.confirmDeleteAccount: This is permanent. Every meeting, recording and task will be deleted.

followUp.safetyTitle: Nothing is sent or triggered without your approval
followUp.safetyBody: Every follow-up action is staged as a draft or a proposal in the inbox and only runs once you approve it.
followUp.draftsHint: Write the draft, then propose it for sending.
followUp.noDraftsBody: Start a follow-up message for your stakeholders.
followUp.sendProposedHint: You'll find it in the proposals inbox — nothing sends without your approval.
followUp.newDraftHint: The draft is saved for you and isn't sent to anyone.
followUp.draftDefaultBody:
Hi,

Thanks for the meeting. Here are the key points we agreed on:

• 

Best regards,
followUp.subject: Subject
followUp.draftIsLocal: The draft stays with you — sending requires approval in the proposals inbox.
followUp.remindersHint: Reminders tied to this meeting's tasks.
followUp.noRemindersBody: Add a reminder to follow up on a task or decision.
followUp.newReminderHint: The reminder becomes a proposal before it's active.
followUp.reminderDefaultNote: Follow up on delivering the meeting's tasks
followUp.reminderNeedsApprovalBody: No reminder is activated until you approve it in the proposals inbox.
followUp.reminderFallback: Follow up on the meeting's output
followUp.footerNote: Every follow-up action needs explicit approval before it runs.
